thread:
Marta (PM): Heads up — competitor launched a close substitute for our reranker yesterday. Several customers pinged us asking when we'll ship comparable behavior. Need quick alignment on scope and tradeoffs.
Dan (Eng): Can you paste the feature spec they shipped? quick look suggests it's a lighter reranker (no cross-encoder), basically an improved scoring hook + candidate filters.
Marta (PM): Yep, link: https://example.com/competitor-release. TL;DR: improved recall for short queries, server-side plugin, no private deployment support at launch. Customers care about accuracy and easy SDK.
Lee (Sales): We heard from ACME, BlinkHealth, and Nova — all asked for parity. ACME said they're pausing a rollout without it. This is a near-term revenue risk.
Anya (CS): If we don't act, risk of churn for ACME. They said it's a blocker unless we can give a firm timeline.
Dan (Eng): Ballpark implementation options:
- Option A: Full-feature parity (cross-encoder reranker, infra tweaks): 6–8 weeks dev + 2 week infra validation.
- Option B: MVP parity (lightweight reranker, model + scoring, hosted only): 3–4 weeks, much lower infra lift.
- Option C: No-build, provide connectors + tuning guidance: 1 week docs + support time.
Jeff (Design): For Option B we should ship a minimal UX: a toggle + explainers, avoid deep integrations at first. Can mock in 2 days.
Marta (PM): Proposed decision criteria: 1) Customer revenue at risk, 2) Engineering cost (dev + infra), 3) Impact on latency/cost per token, 4) Launch criteria (e2e tests + 2 customers in canary).
Lee (Sales): Revenue priority: ACME (high), BlinkHealth (medium), Nova (low). If Option B gets ACME to continue, do it.
Dan (Eng): Risks: cross-encoder is heavy. Option B probably increases median latency ~30% unless we add async scoring + caching. That adds complexity but keepable. We'll need a feature flag and canary rollout path.
Marta (PM): My recommendation: pick Option B with feature-flagged host-only initial rollout, canary to ACME first, then expand. Add a spike for async scoring to mitigate latency if we see regressions.
Anya (CS): For canary we'll need runbooks and a rollback condition (error rate >1% or latency 2x baseline).
DeployBot: CI pipeline check passed for the mock server integration. :white_check_mark:
Dan (Eng): If approved I'll scope tickets: 3 sprints (2-week) with 1 engineer on infra and 2 on model + API. Estimate finish by 5 weeks from now if we push immediately.
Marta (PM): Consensus? If yes I'll create a short spec and kickoff doc and loop in legal for data policies (hosted-only wording).
Lee (Sales): +1 from revenue. Need a one-pager for ACME by EOD.
Jeff (Design): +1, will drop mocks into the kickoff doc.
Anya (CS): +1 — I'll prep canary runbook.
Marta (PM): Ok pushing forward with Option B. Next steps: I'll post a spec (link) and TL;DR for ACME. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
